tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open quarter-finals begin Tuesday — Alcaraz faces Shelton, Sabalenka meets Noskova, and two all-American clashes pit Tiafoe vs Michelsen and Pegula vs Navarro at Flushing Meadows • [SQUASH] Paul Coll defends London Classic with a third straight title and 34th PSA crown, while the Platinum Qatar Classic in Doha opens September 12 • [BADMINTON] An Se-young wins a third straight China Masters for her seventh title of 2026, Satwik-Chirag finally take men's doubles gold, and the Asian Games loom September 19 • [PICKLEBALL] Team USA sweeps Vietnam 4-0 for Heineken Pickleball World Cup Open gold in Da Nang as Ly Hoang Nam wins men's singles after four finals in one day • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao 2026 kicks off at the East Asian Games Dome — defending champion Wang Chuqin withdraws injured as the world's top 32 open Round of 32 play

newsItems.title: US Open Quarter-Finals Begin
newsItems.excerpt: Tuesday's line-up features Carlos Alcaraz against Ben Shelton and Aryna Sabalenka versus Linda Noskova, with Frances Tiafoe meeting Alex Michelsen and Jessica Pegula facing Emma Navarro in two all-American quarter-finals.

newsItems.title: An Se-young Claims Seventh Title of 2026
newsItems.excerpt: The world No. 1 beat Tomoka Miyazaki 21-17, 21-6 to win a third straight China Masters crown, while Satwik-Chirag ended years of heartbreak with their first men's doubles title in Shenzhen.

newsItems.title: USA Crowned Pickleball World Cup Champions
newsItems.excerpt: Team USA swept host Vietnam 4-0 in the Open team final in Da Nang, though Ly Hoang Nam claimed men's singles gold after playing four finals in a single day.

newsItems.title: WTT Champions Macao Gets Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The $800,000 Champions event opened Tuesday at the Macao East Asian Games Dome with Round of 32 singles play, as defending men's champion Wang Chuqin withdrew injured ahead of the draw.
